title: The board
about: `apps/web` shows the workflows to a person.

terms.meaning: `apps/web`, the pages a person looks at, which reach the api over HTTP alone.

a step of a run her chat message links to (`/runs/<run>?step=<step>`), drawn under her words as the run's page's own part for what it waits on, read live: its gate, the Answer section's row, the banner's Continue, the note of a try asked, or its state alone, as `broughtPart` names it (`apps/web/src/lib/brought.ts`, proved by `apps/web/contracts/brought.contract.ts`), drawn by `apps/web/src/components/nemia/chat/ChatBrought.tsx`. A proposal her message links to (`/factories/<factory>/proposals/<name>`, read by `proposalLinkOf`, `apps/web/src/lib/proposalLink.ts`) is brought the same way, as the proposal page's own part (`ProposalCard`, `apps/web/src/components/gate/ProposalCard.tsx`), drawn by `apps/web/src/components/nemia/chat/ChatProposal.tsx`; her action ask is `ChatActions` (`apps/web/src/components/nemia/chat/ChatActions.tsx`).

a person's word for each phase of a factory's proposal, its sentence on hover and its hue, one writer: `PROPOSAL_WORDS` (`apps/web/src/lib/words.ts`); which of Approve and Decline a phase offers is `proposalOffers` (`apps/web/src/lib/proposals.ts`, proved by `apps/web/contracts/proposal.contract.ts`).

what comes with Nemia, as the board says it: the place `builtin` of a skill, drawn 'Built into Nemia', the builtin servers above a factory's list and an agent's builtin auto rule. The former address `/agents/skills/shipped/<skill>` opens the builtin skill through the api's redirect.

terms.meaning: what the board offers a person for a waiting step, in the run's Answer section and its banner: its `kind` is the key of the step's `commands` whose line it presses (`retry`, `approve`, `say`), its `case` why the step waits (`answer`, `try-again`, `denied`, `raise`, `continue`, `enough`), and a person's words for each case are `OFFERS`'. A try already asked is a note beside the step, not an offer.

terms.meaning: the board's word for each start of a try's task, which the runtime calls an attempt: a try counts its sessions, one a start. Not the runtime's Session, an agent's conversation, which a try may continue.
which of the board's five groups a step is drawn in (work, gate, done, to come, failed), taken from its phase and whether it ran (`kindOf`).

the board's state of a step, drawn from its reason by one total table in `apps/web/src/lib/status.ts`, never from the words of its message; a question its session asks, `AwaitingAnswer` via `session`, is `asks-in-session`, and the runtime's `needs-human` is compared nowhere in the board (`apps/web/test/structure.test.ts`).

terms.meaning: one filing of a step, as the api serves it, with its cause; the board says try and never attempt.

the states of a step that wait on a person's word (`WAITS_ON_A_PERSON` in `apps/web/src/lib/status.ts`), read by `waitsOnPerson`; of them, the human gates (`AT_A_GATE`: signed off blocked, at its gate, a loop out of rounds, past its budget), read by `waitsAtGate` and drawn with the gate's badge. Neither waits on a run called off. A row's kind of wait (`WaitKind`, `apps/web/src/lib/runWords.ts`) for a step that signed off blocked is `answer`.

retired.card: 4c: a human gate is read by `waitsAtGate`, of the states `waitsOnPerson` reads

terms.meaning: the field over the Inbox and the Runs (`SelectorField`, `apps/web/src/components/field/SelectorField.tsx`) that keeps the cards or the runs a label selector takes (`team=core`, Kubernetes' spelling), written to the address as `?l=` and sent to the api as `?selector=`; a selector the api refuses is said in its words under the field.

the page of one label value, `/labels/<key>/<value>` (`apps/web/src/routes/labels.$key.$value.tsx`): the cards that carry it no run started, the runs that carry it counted by where each stands (waiting, running, needs a person, landed, failed, stopped), and what a landed one cost, each linking to its list filtered by it.

the factory a run or a card that names none is in, `default` (objects' `DEFAULT_NAMESPACE`), and the board's two converters of it, written once in `apps/web/src/lib/api/namespace.ts` and re-exported by `apps/web/src/lib/factories.ts`: `namespaceOf`, from a factory as the api answers it (null for the default) to its namespace, and `factoryIn`, the way back.

terms.meaning: one step as every size of it is drawn — the graph's node, the preview card, and whole in the ledger, the bar and the step's page — from one model, `stepPartOf` (`apps/web/src/lib/stepPart.ts`): six slots in an order a size never changes, only leaves some out (head, asks of you, got, said, gave, detail), each `none` where it does not apply, of the try the address shows (`?try=<step>:<n>`, `tryShown`, `apps/web/src/lib/tryAddress.ts`, proved by `apps/web/contracts/try-shown.contract.ts`). Its head is the one writer of the words the step's card says (`headOf`).

what a step hands the step whose `input` names it: drawn on the graph's edge between them, labelled by the giver's name, with the fields and files the giver's shown try gave; the giver's Gave and the taker's Got say the same label (`packetsOf`, `apps/web/src/lib/canvas.ts`).
a folded record at the foot of a run's page, read when a person wants to check rather than act: its timeline, its checks, its specs, its tokens, and where it ran.

what draws a declared field of a step's output, chosen once per field from its schema and the shape its `x-shape` marks, never from its value, so the field looks the same before its step runs (a dash) and on every run: `widgetOf` (`apps/web/src/lib/fieldWidget.ts`, proved by `apps/web/contracts/field-widget.contract.ts`).

what draws a step's file in a sheet with an address of its own (`?view=<step>/<path>`, `apps/web/src/lib/viewAddress.ts`), which Back closes: a picture, markdown, JSON or text, by the kind the api serves it as and its extension, never its bytes, and none for a file it cannot draw, offered by its link (`viewerOf`, `apps/web/src/lib/viewers.ts`, proved by `apps/web/contracts/artifact-viewer.contract.ts`).
